text: Chief: scope widened with m1's post-landing findings on f1b75ae (post-01M15EYQBCHE6PXG2MYK7VJD7K): (2) attempt/v2 mutation property must hold cache/policy/result/sensitivity fixed and include separator-forgery pairs — must fail on a stripped renderer; (3) cache Left path must not return the delegate's Plain receipt (mint a call-free Keyed BatchRejected receipt); (4) non-public batches reject empty-item receipts and require Keyed items for uncovered non-public ids; (5) puts check outcome.space == request.space.
